consumesExternalOutput.provenance: A SPEC'S MEMBERS MUST REDDEN EVERY TEST IT NAMES, not merely one of them: src/witness/run.ts:932 computes a run as red only when the exit code is nonzero AND failed.length === tests.length. The first version of this witness named both class tests in one spec and was correctly rejected, because narrowing the status vocabulary cannot reach a test that only uses `gates`. So the schema is covered by two specs of one test each rather than one spec of two, and that is a property of the harness rather than a preference. The capture is verbatim stdout of four consecutive runs of the gate under test, taken on 2026-09-17 against this branch over four copies of one real phase declaration differing in a single class disposition; the named test reads its four asserted detail sentences out of it. THE TWO MEMBERS ARE STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT: the first removes `not-yet-establishable` from the STATUS VOCABULARY, so DR-0029's IOU escape stops being expressible at all, and the second changes the TYPE of the `reason` datum, so `not-applicable` stays expressible and the recorded reason that makes it data rather than silence stops being. One attacks which escapes exist, the other attacks what an escape must carry.
